name: Inquiry Acknowledgement Notification to Customer
script:
# Simple Lead Acknowledgment Email Script # Trigger: After Submit on Lead DocType # Get email from lead recipient_email = doc.get("email_id") if recipient_email: # Prepare customer name customer_name = doc.get("lead_name") or doc.get("first_name") or "Valued Customer" # Email subject subject = f"Thank You for Your Inquiry - Ref: {doc.name}" # Email message message = f"""

Thank You for Your Inquiry!

Dear {customer_name},

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your property inspection needs. We have received your inquiry and our team will review your requirements shortly.

Your Inquiry Details:

Reference Number: {doc.name}

Lead Type: {doc.get('type', 'Property Inspection')}

Job Type: {doc.get('custom_job_type', 'Not specified')}

Email: {doc.get('email_id', 'Not provided')}

Phone: {doc.get('mobile_no', 'Not provided')}

Budget Range: {doc.get('custom_budget_range', 'Not specified')}

Project Urgency: {doc.get('custom_project_urgency', 'Not specified')}

What Happens Next?

  • Our team will review your requirements within 24 hours
  • We'll prepare a customized inspection plan
  • You'll receive a detailed quotation and timeline
  • We'll schedule the inspection at your preferred time

If you have any questions, please contact us at info@yourcompany.com or call +1 (555) 123-4567.

Thank you for choosing us!

Best regards,
Your Property Inspection Team

""" # Send email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment to lead doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Acknowledgment email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for lead: {doc.name}", "Email Missing")

name: Job Estimation - Create Booking Employee
script:
# Check if job_execution child table exists and has data if not doc.get('tentative_schedule_for_execution') or len(doc.get('tentative_schedule_for_execution', [])) == 0: frappe.msgprint(_("No Job Execution records found to create bookings")) else: created_records = [] skipped_records = [] for job_exec in doc.tentative_schedule_for_execution: # Skip if mandatory fields are missing if not job_exec.get('employee') or not job_exec.get('date'): skipped_records.append(f"Row {job_exec.idx}: Missing employee or date") continue # Check if record already exists to avoid duplicates existing_record = frappe.db.exists("Employee Booking", { "employee": job_exec.employee, "date": job_exec.date, "project": doc.name }) if existing_record: skipped_records.append(f"Row {job_exec.idx}: Record already exists ({existing_record})") continue try: # Create new Employee Booking record booking_employee = frappe.new_doc("Employee Booking") # Map fields from Job Execution to Employee Booking booking_employee.employee = job_exec.employee booking_employee.date = job_exec.date booking_employee.project = doc.name # Link to Job Estimation booking_employee.status = "Booked" # Default status print("one" , job_exec.employee) print("two" , job_exec.date) print("three" , doc.name) # Combine remarks with operation info remarks_list = [] if job_exec.get('operation'): remarks_list.append(f"Operation: {job_exec.operation}") if job_exec.get('time'): remarks_list.append(f"Time: {job_exec.time} hrs") if job_exec.get('custom_hourly_rate'): remarks_list.append(f"Rate: {job_exec.custom_hourly_rate}") if job_exec.get('remarks'): remarks_list.append(f"Notes: {job_exec.remarks}") booking_employee.remarks = " | ".join(remarks_list) # Save the record booking_employee.insert() # booking_employee.Save() created_records.append(booking_employee.name) except Exception as e: error_msg = f"Row {job_exec.idx}: {str(e)}" frappe.log_error(f"Error creating Employee Booking record: {error_msg}") skipped_records.append(error_msg) # Show result messages messages = [] if created_records: messages.append(f"✅ Created {len(created_records)} Employee Booking records") if skipped_records: messages.append(f"⚠️ Skipped {len(skipped_records)} records:") for skip in skipped_records: messages.append(f" • {skip}") if messages: frappe.msgprint("
".join(messages), title="Employee Booking Creation Result")
